valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the period FY2023 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the period FY2023 reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2023, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.basis: current market cap vs the interim period both statements cover
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E a PEG divides is itself withheld, so there is no P/E to divide by the growth rate. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.note: loss-making in the latest period, so P/E is not meaningful
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: total equity is not on file for FY2024, so a P/B cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2024, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2025, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the newest period both the income statement and the balance sheet cover is the interim H1 2025, whose flows cover only part of a year and are not annualised, so a market multiple built on them would not be a year's multiple. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

derived.enterpriseValueBasis: market cap + borrowings - cash, both from the balance sheet for FY2023
